title: Profile of the Protest
proposition: The Protest does not introduce a new problem or contest a separation already understood by the patient; it restores the underweighted first paragraph of the GP referral and says the feet have not been properly dealt with, so the neurological work cannot therefore be complete.

title: Documentary Selection
proposition: The portable account preserves separation-compatible material while omitting the event that restored the originating referral problem before closure.

title: Profile of the Discharge Summary
proposition: The discharge synthesis is the founding join: it contains the dystonic-looking lower-limb, structural-foot, Parkinsonism and PRKN material, then allocates explanatory force so the painful feet can travel through a separate/peripheral-neuropathy/'Not clear'/Podiatry channel while the neurological disease architecture is developed elsewhere.

title: Profile of the Treating Neurologist's Knowledge
proposition: By closure the treating neurologist had the integrated referral state, the dystonic-looking lower-limb sign, structural feet and possible PRKN/PARK2, then received the patient's direct restoration of the originating foot problem as unfinished.

title: The Patient as a Documentary Knowledge-State
proposition: The record carries a stronger separation-compatible patient state ('markedly divorced') while the patient's later warning that the originating referral problem remained unfinished is not preserved in the founding portable synthesis.

title: Self-Validating Record
proposition: Later documentary continuity is used as evidence of the adequacy of the process that produced and preserved the founding directional join.

title: The Record as Its Own Witness
proposition: The restored referral problem, its omission from the founding portable account, later continuity and 2025 retrospective reliance form one recursive evidential structure.

title: The Information State the Discharge Created
proposition: The discharge synthesis creates the starting geometry from which later care inherits meaning: Parkinsonism/PRKN on one side; painful feet permitted to travel through separate/peripheral-neuropathy/'Not clear'/Podiatry territory on the other.

title: ‘Not Clear’: Uncertainty Inside a Directional Join
proposition: 'Not clear' sits inside a synthesis that has already joined the known elements directionally and given the painful feet an operational destination; uncertainty remains, but it is not directionless.

title: Natural Experiments
proposition: Treatment response, withdrawal and OFF states repeatedly test the direction and adequacy of the founding join.

title: The Life of ‘Not Clear’
proposition: Tracks how the founding separate-or-neuropathic foot channel survives despite later evidence repeatedly crossing its boundaries.

title: Profile of the GP, the Referral and Eight Years of Primary Care
proposition: The GP supplies the original whole-problem architecture and repeatedly regenerates the integrated feet–gait–tone–pain formulation later.

title: The Constrained Steward of the Founding Frame
proposition: Later facts are repeatedly managed within the directional architecture created by the founding synthesis.

title: Missing Re-joining Function
proposition: The founding join already exists in the discharge synthesis; what is not identified later is a durable owner or operation that rejoins structural-foot information with dynamic neurological treatment-state information and reconstructs the founding model when required.

title: What Never Happened
proposition: Catalogues the absent or unidentified integrating operations after the referral-return moment and later boundary tests: post-Protest neurological reopening, defined handover question, return criterion, later remapping and global re-join/reconstruction.

title: The Closed Documentary System
proposition: The founding directional synthesis, inherited record and 2025 review form a closed documentary system when continuity is used to validate the historical frame without an identified global reconstruction.

title: Forks Not Taken
proposition: Identifies the post-Protest opportunity to reopen the restored referral problem and later opportunities where local management proceeds without global reconstruction of the founding join.

title: Cross-Institution Information Split
proposition: Podiatry acquires local mechanical truth, Neurology dynamic treatment-state truth, and primary care longitudinal integration without a durable mechanism that rejoins those streams against the founding synthesis.

title: Eight Days Into Eight Years
proposition: Compresses the eight-day admission, the referral-return decision point and the later years of repeated opportunities to reconstruct the directional join.

title: Treatment-State Causation: Procyclidine, Formulation and the Feet
proposition: Procyclidine response and withdrawal show that the integrated phenotype could change with neurological treatment state without requiring one exclusive mechanism.

title: Left Fifth MTPJ
proposition: The recurrent fifth-MTPJ site supplies the local mechanical tracer that can be read beside Neurology's treatment-state observations and used to test the founding directional join.

title: Patient as the Only Continuous Integrator
proposition: The patient remains the only guaranteed continuous integrator across services and treatment states.

title: Spin-Generated Complexity
proposition: Tests whether apparent complexity is partly generated by preserving the founding directional arrangement as later facts accumulate without global reconstruction.

title: What Would a Reasonable Reviewer Have to Believe?
proposition: Identifies assumptions required to treat the documentary history as complete and independently reliable.

title: What Trust Is Required to Believe the Record?
proposition: Identifies layers of trust required before the record can be treated as self-sufficient.

title: Proof Strength
proposition: Separates direct proof from propositions requiring expert, provenance, causation or intent evidence.

title: Profile of the Case
proposition: Synthesises the case as whole referral, asymmetric clinical weighting, patient restoration of paragraph one, directional founding synthesis and failed longitudinal reconstruction.

title: Profile of the Allegation
proposition: States the allegation in disciplined documentary and clinical propositions without requiring a single foot mechanism or private motive.

title: Profile of Predictability
proposition: Tests increasing foreseeability as later signals repeatedly cross the founding directional boundary.

title: Profile of Improvement, Loss of Ground and Eventual Severity
proposition: Documents longitudinal change and severity relevant to materiality.

title: Pain, Psychological Distress and Safeguarding
proposition: Documents pain, distress and safeguarding consequences.

title: Minimum Adequate Alternative
proposition: Defines ordinary alternatives after the patient restored paragraph one: reassess, seek input, preserve an explicit neurological question, define ownership and a return mechanism, without assuming that Parkinsonism or the non-levodopa strategy had to be abandoned.

title: What the GP Still Does Not Know
proposition: Tests what primary care could not know when the patient's restoration of the original referral problem was absent from the specialist portable account.

title: Profile of the Hospital Stay
proposition: Provides the eight-day chronology, the neurological discoveries and the observable asymmetry between extensive Parkinsonism/PRKN work and comparatively limited surviving direct foot evaluation before the Protest.

title: Patient Profile at Entry to Neurology — July 2017
proposition: Defines the whole referred problem: painful abnormal feet and gait escalating into pathological neurological signs and functional loss.

title: Clinical Environment Profile — Galway Neurology, July 2017
proposition: Maps the specialist environment, senior input and movement-disorder / young-onset expertise relevant both to the sophisticated Parkinsonism/PRKN formulation and to the objective commitment-pressure context by the time of the Protest.

title: Profile of Complexity
proposition: Explains apparent complexity without displacing the simple causal hierarchy: whole referral, asymmetric weighting, referral return, directional synthesis, later failed reconstruction.

title: What Motivated the Record?
proposition: Private pride or concealment is not proved or required. The record does support investigation of objective professional-coherence / commitment pressure created when the patient restored the underweighted referral problem after substantial diagnostic, hierarchical and therapeutic investment.
